Straight answers before you decide
==================================

Here are the questions I hear most.


"WHAT DOES IT COST?"

Your audit is free. If we work together, I price it after a call, based on what you need. It is a startup fee plus a fee tied to new customers I help you win. I will explain it on the call.


"HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE?"

A standard project is about 5 weeks from kickoff to launch.


"CAN I JUST DO IT MYSELF?"

Yes. The framework is yours. Many people use it on their own. If you get stuck, I am here.


"WHAT IF I AM NOT HAPPY?"

See the guarantee in my last email. Full refund, or I keep working until you are happy.
